name: @vertex/web-editor
description: Standalone code editor Web Components built with Angular Elements and CodeMirror 6. Includes a full editable editor (<vertex-editor>) and a read-only lite variant (<vertex-editor-lite>).

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:aot && bun run build:lite:aot
scripts.build:aot: ng build --project web-editor --configuration production && bun run bundle:aot
scripts.build:lite:angular: ng build --project web-editor-lite --configuration production && bun run bundle:lite:aot
scripts.build:jit: bun run compile && bun run bundle:jit
scripts.bundle:aot: echo 'import "./web-editor/browser/main.js";' > dist/entry.js && npx esbuild dist/entry.js --bundle --outfile=dist/web-editor.min.js --format=iife --global-name=WebEditor --minify --sourcemap --platform=browser && cp dist/web-editor.min.js dist/web-editor-aot.min.js && cp dist/web-editor.min.js.map dist/web-editor-aot.min.js.map
scripts.bundle:lite:aot: echo 'import "./web-editor-lite/browser/main.js";' > dist/entry-lite.js && npx esbuild dist/entry-lite.js --bundle --outfile=dist/web-editor-lite.min.js --format=iife --global-name=WebEditorLite --minify --sourcemap --platform=browser && cp dist/web-editor-lite.min.js dist/web-editor-lite-aot.min.js && cp dist/web-editor-lite.min.js.map dist/web-editor-lite-aot.min.js.map
scripts.bundle:lite:native: npx esbuild src/native/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/web-editor-lite.min.js --format=iife --global-name=WebEditorLite --minify --sourcemap --platform=browser && cp dist/web-editor-lite.min.js dist/web-editor-lite-aot.min.js && cp dist/web-editor-lite.min.js.map dist/web-editor-lite-aot.min.js.map

author: Andrii Pap
